findings.description: No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest by default.
The bucket stores ledger export data but has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined for this bucket, so model artifacts are stored without encryption at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so operational runbook data is stored unencrypted at rest.

This object is uploaded into aws_s3_bucket.reports_archive, which has no server-side encryption configured, meaning the vendor roster file (potentially containing sensitive vendor data) is stored in cleartext at rest.
